name: mod-collision-guard
description: Pauses an edit when another open session edited the same file moments ago, and asks whether to proceed, move to a worktree, cancel or say something else

enabled.title: Guard edits
enabled.description: Ask before an edit lands on a file another open session edited recently. Off, edits are still recorded for other sessions but never paused

window_minutes.title: Window (minutes)
window_minutes.description: How long another session's edit counts as recent

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: auto uses Nerd Font icons when Windows Terminal runs a Nerd Font, and safe Unicode glyphs elsewhere. nerd and safe force one
